name: apply
content:
With `apply`, you apply an implication `hAB : A → B`:

| before | tactic           | after |
|:------------ |:---------------- |:-------- |
| `⊢ B`        | `apply hAB`      | `⊢ A`    |
| `h : A `     | `apply hAB at h` | `h : B`  |

In both cases, the implication `hAB` can either be
given as an assumption or be an already known lemma.
